name: City-Owned Land Inventory
attribution: Chicago Department of Planning and Development

Metadata.Time Period: Current as of the last update
Metadata.Data Owner: Chicago Department of Planning and Development

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the record located in the underlying system.

columns.name: PIN
columns.description: Property Index Number

columns.name: Managing Organization
columns.description: The City department or other entity managing the property. A blank or "None" value may (but does not necessarily) indicate a property available for sale. For any questions about potential sales, please contact landsales@cityofchicago.org. See http://dev.cityofchicago.org/open%20data/data%20portal/2020/08/11/city-owned-property.html for more information, including descriptions of common values.

columns.name: Property Status
columns.description: Whether the property is currently held or has been sold by the city.

columns.name: Date of Acquisition
columns.description: Date that the property was originally acquired by the city. If the property was re-acquired after initially holding it, the date of acquisition will only reflect the original purchase date.

columns.name: Date of Disposition
columns.description: Date the property was sold by City of Chicago. Will only appear if Property Status is currently or has been marked "Sold".

columns.name: Times Listed
columns.description: Number of times the property been listed for sale.

columns.name: Last Listed
columns.description: When the property was last listed for sale.

columns.name: Sales Status
columns.description: A notation indicating the parcel’s status on the ChiBlockBuilder land sales platform.

columns.name: Sale Offering Status
columns.description: Whether the parcel is or may soon be available for sale.

columns.name: Sale Offering Reason
columns.description: More information on the reason the property is or is not for sale and, if for sale, the types of use required or preferred.

columns.name: Sq. Ft.
columns.description: Parcel square footage according to the Cook County Recorder of Deeds' database. Please see the immediately following column for an alternative estimate.

columns.name: Square Footage - City Estimate
columns.description: For internal purposes, the City of Chicago estimates the size of the parcel. This estimate will sometimes differ from the Cook County Recorder of Deeds number. (Sq. Ft.).  The number in this column is used for most/all City purposes but both are provided so public users can use either or both, as needed.

columns.name: Land Value
columns.description: Market value of the parcel as of the Valuation Date.

columns.name: Valuation Date
columns.description: The date on which the Land Value was determined.

columns.name: Last Update
columns.description: Date that the property was last updated in the system. Updates may include changes that are not seen on the data portal.

columns.name: Application Use
columns.description: How the land will be used by a buyer.

columns.name: Grouped Parcels
columns.description: Parcels of land the City has grouped as a unit to sell.

columns.name: Application Opens
columns.description: The date the application to buy the property opens.

columns.name: Application Deadline
columns.description: Deadline for buyer to apply for advertised City land.

columns.name: Offer Round
columns.description: Time period when the City offers the land for sale.

columns.name: Application URL
columns.description: Link to the application to buy.

columns.name: X Coordinate
columns.description: The x coordinate of the location for the property in State Plane Illinois East NAD 1983 projection.

columns.name: Y Coordinate
columns.description: The y coordinate of the location for the property in State Plane Illinois East NAD 1983 projection.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the property using WGS84.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the property using WGS84.
